Requirement: [E]nable users to submit prior authorization requests

Support submitting a prior authorization request as a client in accordance with at least one of the versions of the implementation specification adopted in § 170.215(j)(3) [([*Prior authorization submission*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-5994)) currently including only [PAS 2.0.1](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pas/STU2/)]
Support registration capabilities applicable to a client system.

Support system authentication and authorization as a client in accordance with the “Backend Services” section of at least one of the versions of the implementation specification adopted in § 170.215(c) [([*Application access and launch*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-5973)) currently including SMART App Launch versions [1.0.0](https://hl7.org/fhir/smart-app-launch/1.0.0/) and [2.0.0](https://hl7.org/fhir/smart-app-launch/STU2/)].
Support the ability to submit a prior authorization request as a client system
Support the capabilities in the “EHR PAS Capabilities” Capability Statement.
Support the ability to consume and process a “ClaimResponse.”

Support subscriptions as a client according to the requirements in paragraph (j)(21) [([*Subscriptions—client*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-6095))] of this section in order to support “pended authorization responses.”

Supported subscriptions client endpoint capabilities for the “REST-Hook” channel from implementation specifications adopted in § 170.215(j)(3)  [([*Prior authorization submission*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-5994)) currently including only [PAS 2.0.1](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pas/STU2/)] must include complete accompanying technical documentation.

Support subscriptions as a client according to at least one of the implementation specifications in § 170.215(h) [([*API-based event notifications*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-5986)) currently including only [Subscriptions R5 Backport v1.1.0](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/subscriptions-backport/STU1.1/)]
Support the requirements in section “Topic-Based Subscriptions—FHIR R4.”
Support the accompanying client capabilities for the minimum requirements included in the “R4 Topic-Based Subscription Server Capability Statement”
Receive subscription notifications according to section “Topic-Based Subscriptions—FHIR R4”
[S]upport ... consuming notifications via the “REST-Hook” channel as specified in the “Channels” section.
